matriarch.note: Nine uneven throats venting spore swarms and a brood sac of larvae: Spawning Surge reads at a glance. s37 rejected (grew a head).

mending.note: Living Suture-Hive (R37): honeycomb hive flesh sewn shut with rows of bone stitches, amber nursing sacs dripping onto new flesh. No face, no body. Batch 1 Mending renders all rejected (faces); b2 s23 rejected (sacs read as a skull face).

vex.note: Oath scars, wax seals and parchment strips, orange broadside beams through a gothic viewport. Z-Image takes rejected (sea-going battleships in the window, small face).

kassar.note: Targeting grid on the face, gloved hands, rows of firing-solution displays. Z-Image takes rejected (gun pictograms on the screens).

grax.note: Iron jaw, red cyber eye, boarding axe, patchwork plates in clashing colours from three fleets, sparks.

aelith.note: Robed rerun (batch 2): crested skull, gold light channels, light sails, star-craft murmuration. Batch 1 rejected (nude torso, five fingers).

nekhet.note: Broken ring of bone-white computation plates around a green core, repair drones, no figure (batch 2). Batch 1 rejected (torso or a face in every render).
